title: Job Interview
description: Practice answering common interview questions clearly and professionally.
descriptionZh: 练习清晰、自然地回答常见英文面试问题。

context.setting: A first-round job interview for a product or software role.
context.learnerPurpose: Answer questions with clear structure, relevant examples, and confident tone.

goals.label: Give a concise self-introduction
successCriteria: Mentions background, strengths, and target role
Keeps the answer under one minute

goals.label: Answer one behavioral question
successCriteria: Uses a clear situation, action, and result
Connects the example to the role

constraints: Keep the conversation realistic and professional.
Ask one interview question at a time.
Avoid overly advanced business jargon unless the learner uses it first.
